scopeDefinition: Bounded path-level dependency candidate for the current package entrypoints, unchanged compiler/package interfaces, the exact 555-regression scope and existing G7 CUA support. This is not a proof of a mathematically minimal hunk set, not approval to stage whole files, and not clean-commit validation. Excluding unrelated features while editing their entrypoints would be a different unverified implementation.

primaryTenMissingBaselineFiles.why: 01 adds v2/history/reference tests to the existing P1/G5–G7 plan and canvas integration harness.
01 adds v2 admin↔official-SDK and concurrency tests to the existing P3 workspace/bootstrap/grant harness.
The existing P1/P2 inspection function is the entry for v2 pending/declared-evidence warnings.
The existing P1 save/read/validate transaction owns immutable plan revisions, administrator checks, idempotency and G5 canvas persistence.
The G6/G7 planning session owns draft preservation, save intents, revision conflicts and layout state used by the new panel.
G6/G7 module/dependency/layout helpers are extended with v2 defaults and exact runtime identity.
The G1–G8 workspace mounts the new panel; its existing O2/O3 imports require method/run UI dependencies.
P3 project tool registration exposes the shared plan contracts over the existing five-domain SDK transport.
P1/G5 immutable plan/module/layout contracts are extended by the strict v1/v2 union.
P3 bootstrap and plan tools must consume the same strict versioned plan schema.

approvalNeeded: A separate historical-baseline commit for the enumerated dependencies and selected necessary hunks, then the 01 increment, or another explicitly chosen coherent scope. Existing 555 tests cover the working tree; any selected commit snapshot must be independently verified before it is described as reproducible.

staticImportAnalysis.definition: Static imports from current application/package entrypoints plus 01 tests and required package/schema/migration configuration. Unchanged HEAD dependencies remain supplied by HEAD. Generated Prisma clients and dist outputs are regenerated, not staged. Path reachability does not authorize every historical hunk of a tracked file. Clean-snapshot validation has not run.
